name: One Way or Another
source:
Credence is your average college student living an average college life. It's not the most exciting routine in the world, but honestly, Credence couldn't ask for anything more than the company of his two best friends.

But then something more *does* show up,  coming out of the blue to declare his intention to sweep him off his feet. Now, caught in a love triangle between his old childhood friend and this new mysterious stranger, Credence must grapple with a difficult question...the question of how he's going to tell them he doesn't want either of them.

[From [url=https://undertheblacklight.itch.io/one-way-or-another]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克莱登斯是过着普通大学生活的普通大学生。这不是世界上最令人兴奋的例行公事，但老实说，克雷登斯除了他两个最好的朋友的陪伴之外别无他求。

但随后，更多的事情“确实”出现了，突然出现，宣布他打算让他神魂颠倒。现在，克莱登斯陷入了他儿时的老朋友和这个新的神秘陌生人之间的三角恋，他必须解决一个难题……他将如何告诉他们他不想要他们中的任何一个。

[来自[url=https://undertheblacklight.itch.io/one-way-or-another]Itch.io[/url]]
